offering_description.value: Owns and operates digital media brands that publish lifestyle, health, food, home and personal finance content for consumers, and sells advertising and commerce placements against that audience to brands and agencies. Revenue comes from ads on its websites and apps, sponsored content, and affiliate commissions on product recommendations.

primary_products.value: digital publications; print magazines; recipe and cooking sites; health information sites; personal finance sites

primary_services.value: custom advertising and sponsored content; affiliate commerce; audience data and marketing services

customer_segment.value: B2C: readers and consumers who use its websites, apps and magazines; B2B: advertisers, brand marketers, advertising agencies and retail partners

end_markets.value: digital advertising; publishing; consumer lifestyle; health information; retail and e-commerce

revenue_model.value: advertising: display, video and sponsored content sold to brands and agencies; commissions or management fees: affiliate commissions when readers buy recommended products; licensing or royalties: licensing of editorial content and brand names to third parties
revenue_model.category: advertising; commissions or management fees; licensing or royalties

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: owns consumer media titles and sells their audiences to advertisers; service provider: creates custom marketing content and campaigns for advertisers

geography_served.value: global: Largest audience in the United States, with international editions and audiences in other countries

specialization.value: related lines: lifestyle, health, food, home and personal finance brands that share advertisers and digital audiences

distribution_channels.value: online: own websites and mobile apps where readers access content directly; partners / resellers: search engines, social media platforms and content syndication partners; direct sales: advertising sales teams selling to brands and agencies

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: consumer data privacy and advertising rules, including FTC endorsement and affiliate disclosure rules

notes: The current portfolio is uncertain after the 2025 separation of Angi and other changes, so this describes the media business as I best understand it.
